steps.label: push
steps.run: L="$HOME/ShortsRenderAgent/music/lib"; ls -R "$L" | head -400 > mlist.txt; a=""; for n in Inspired Investigations Intrepid; do f=$(find "$L" -name "$n.mp3" | head -1); [ -n "$f" ] && a="$a $f euv/music_$n.mp3"; done; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" mlist.txt euv/mlist.txt $a
